## 2. 从原免疫相关宿主候选集合及现有物种中，仅用训练折26人筛选

重要区别：每折仅根据训练者的表达量/丰度决定**合格特征集**，再使用这26人的T2载量进行关联分析。
不能先在全27人筛出560/35再做LOOCV。

- 宿主：原完整免疫相关候选基因集合中，Spearman名义P<0.05且相关方向与训练者零/非零组均值差一致。最终条件与原host_analysis.Rmd一致；不要求Wilcoxon显著。
- DNA：`op_dna_species` 的全部行，训练者相对丰度>0.1%（至少一人），Spearman(T2 `psedo1`) 或 Wilcoxon(T2中位数高/低组)。
- RNA：`op_rna_species` 的全部行，训练者相对丰度>1%（至少一人），Spearman(T2连续载量) 或 Wilcoxon(T2中位数高/低组)。
- 原始 `MOFA.Rmd` 最终用于微生物视图的是DNA物种**计数**经CLR转换。为与原分析可比，仍然从 `DNA_species_count` 取所选物种计数。RNA-only且无DNA计数的物种在日志中标记，不能冒充其有DNA计数。
- 宿主固定名义P<0.05加方向一致性；use_fdr仅影响微生物筛选。无特征时停止，不根据AUC改参数。

```{r screening}
association_tests <- function(x, response, tr, case_group, include_wilcox=TRUE){
  stopifnot(is.matrix(x),length(tr)==26L,length(case_group)==length(tr),
            any(case_group),any(!case_group))
  if(nrow(x)<1L) stop('No eligible features after fold-specific abundance/CPM filter')
  yy <- response[tr]
  if(sd(yy)<=1e-12) stop('Constant viral load within training fold')
  ans <- t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(x)),function(i){
    a <- as.numeric(x[i,tr])
    if(any(!is.finite(a)) || sd(a)<1e-12)
      return(c(r=0,p_cor=1,p_wilcox=1,difference=0))
    cor_p <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(a,yy,method='spearman'))
    wc <- if(include_wilcox)
      suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a[case_group],a[!case_group]))$p.value else 1
    c(r=unname(cor_p$estimate),p_cor=cor_p$p.value,
      p_wilcox=wc,difference=mean(a[case_group])-mean(a[!case_group]))
  },numeric(4)))
  ans <- data.frame(feature=rownames(x),ans,check.names=FALSE,row.names=NULL)
  ans$p_cor[!is.finite(ans$p_cor)]<-1
  ans$p_wilcox[!is.finite(ans$p_wilcox)]<-1
  ans$FDR_cor <- p.adjust(ans$p_cor,method='BH')
  ans$FDR_wilcox <- if(include_wilcox)
    p.adjust(ans$p_wilcox,method='BH') else rep(1,nrow(ans))
  ans
}
screen_features <- function(tr){
  # Wilcoxon uses the SAME median-defined high/low groups as the RF target.
  case_group <- as.character(train_label[tr]) == '1'
  stopifnot(any(case_group),any(!case_group))
  # 仅看这26人是否超过预先规定的检测/丰度阈值
  # Original host screening has no additional CPM>5 filter at this stage.
  good_genes <- rep(TRUE,nrow(hc))
  good_dna <- rowSums(dn[,tr,drop=FALSE] > dna_abundance_min) >= 1L
  good_rna <- rowSums(rn[,tr,drop=FALSE] > rna_abundance_min) >= 1L

  # Preserve original host direction comparison: nonzero versus zero.
  host_case_group <- Ypseudo[tr] != 0
  stopifnot(any(host_case_group),any(!host_case_group))
  h <- association_tests(host_screen[good_genes,,drop=FALSE],Y,tr,host_case_group,FALSE)
  d <- association_tests(dn[good_dna,,drop=FALSE],Ypseudo,tr,case_group,TRUE)
  r <- association_tests(rn[good_rna,,drop=FALSE],Y,tr,case_group,TRUE)

  p_cor_col <- if(use_fdr)'FDR_cor' else 'p_cor'
  p_wil_col <- if(use_fdr)'FDR_wilcox' else 'p_wilcox'
  h$direction_consistent <- h$r * h$difference > 0
  h$selected <- h$p_cor < 0.05 & h$direction_consistent
  d$selected <- d[[p_cor_col]] < screen_p_cutoff |
    d[[p_wil_col]] < screen_p_cutoff
  r$selected <- r[[p_cor_col]] < screen_p_cutoff |
    r[[p_wil_col]] < screen_p_cutoff

  genes <- unique(h$feature[h$selected])
  selected_dna <- unique(d$feature[d$selected])
  selected_rna <- unique(r$feature[r$selected])
  union_taxa <- union(selected_dna,selected_rna)
  taxa <- intersect(union_taxa,rownames(dc))
  excluded_rna_no_DNA <- setdiff(selected_rna,rownames(dc))
  audit <- data.frame(
    host_total_available=nrow(e$hrna_symbol),host_original_candidates=nrow(hc),host_tested=nrow(h),host_selected=length(genes),
    DNA_total=nrow(dn),DNA_pass_abundance=nrow(d),
    DNA_selected=length(selected_dna),
    RNA_total=nrow(rn),RNA_pass_abundance=nrow(r),
    RNA_selected=length(selected_rna),
    selected_taxa_union=length(union_taxa),
    selected_taxa_with_DNA_counts=length(taxa),
    selected_RNA_taxa_without_DNA_counts=length(excluded_rna_no_DNA),
    microbe_use_fdr=use_fdr,host_rule=host_rule,host_nominal_p_cutoff=0.05
  )
  list(genes=genes,taxa=taxa,union_taxa=union_taxa,
       dna_taxa=selected_dna,rna_taxa=selected_rna,
       rna_without_dna=excluded_rna_no_DNA,
       host_tests=h,dna_tests=d,rna_tests=r,audit=audit)
}
```

## 3. 冻结训练集VST

下方公式对应本机DESeq2的getVarianceStabilizedData。
local分支冻结整个变换函数，而非只冻结dispersionFunction。
函数首先验证它对训练数据的结果与DESeq2内置结果一致，再用于测试者。

```{r frozen_vst}
freeze_vst <- function(d){
 normalized <- counts(d,normalized=TRUE)
 trend <- dispersionFunction(d);fit_type <- attr(trend,'fitType')
 if(fit_type=='parametric'){
  coefs <- attr(trend,'coefficients')
  fun <- function(q)log((1+coefs['extraPois']+2*coefs['asymptDisp']*q+
   2*sqrt(coefs['asymptDisp']*q*(1+coefs['extraPois']+coefs['asymptDisp']*q)))/(4*coefs['asymptDisp']))/log(2)
 }else if(fit_type=='local'){
  xg <- sinh(seq(asinh(0),asinh(max(normalized)),length.out=1000))[-1]
  xim <- mean(1/sizeFactors(d))
  integrand <- 1/sqrt(trend(xg)*xg^2+xim*xg)
  splf <- splinefun(asinh((xg[-1]+xg[-length(xg)])/2),
   cumsum((xg[-1]-xg[-length(xg)])*(integrand[-1]+integrand[-length(integrand)])/2))
  h1 <- as.numeric(quantile(rowMeans(normalized),.95))
  h2 <- as.numeric(quantile(rowMeans(normalized),.999))
  eta <- (log2(h2)-log2(h1))/(splf(asinh(h2))-splf(asinh(h1)))
  xi <- log2(h1)-eta*splf(asinh(h1))
  stopifnot(is.finite(eta),is.finite(xi))
  fun <- function(q)eta*splf(asinh(q))+xi
 }else if(fit_type=='mean'){
  alpha <- attr(trend,'mean')
  fun <- function(q)(2*asinh(sqrt(alpha*q))-log(alpha)-log(4))/log(2)
 }else stop('Unsupported VST fit type: ',fit_type)
 expected <- assay(varianceStabilizingTransformation(d,blind=FALSE))
 actual <- matrix(fun(normalized),nrow=nrow(normalized))
 error <- max(abs(actual-expected))
 if(!is.finite(error)||error>1e-6)stop('Frozen VST training check failed: ',error)
 list(transform=fun,training=expected,error=error,type=fit_type,train_max=max(normalized))
}
prepare_host <- function(raw,tr,j){
 stopifnot(all(raw>=0),all(abs(raw-round(raw))<1e-6))
 raw <- raw[rowSums(raw[,tr,drop=FALSE])>0,,drop=FALSE]
 counts1 <- round(raw)+1
 # Same median-ratio size-factor estimator as original; reference from training only.
 gm <- exp(rowMeans(log(counts1[,tr,drop=FALSE])))
 sfraw <- apply(counts1[,tr,drop=FALSE],2,function(x)exp(median(log(x/gm))))
 common <- exp(mean(log(sfraw)))
 d <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts1[,tr,drop=FALSE],data.frame(row.names=ids[tr]),~1)
 sizeFactors(d)<-sfraw/common
 d<-DESeq(d,quiet=TRUE)
 # Original blind=TRUE uses design ~1; refit the trend explicitly so it can be frozen.
 d<-estimateDispersionsFit(d,fitType='parametric',quiet=TRUE)
 fv<-freeze_vst(d)
 sf_test<-exp(median(log(counts1[,j]/gm)))/common
 qtest<-counts1[,j]/sf_test
 h<-matrix(NA_real_,nrow(counts1),n,dimnames=list(rownames(counts1),ids))
 h[,tr]<-fv$training;h[,j]<-fv$transform(qtest)
 stopifnot(all(is.finite(h)))
 list(matrix=h,type=fv$type,error=fv$error,
      test_above_training_range=sum(qtest>fv$train_max),size_factor_test=sf_test)
}
```

## 4. 只拟合训练者MOFA、逐折自动选因子，并投影测试者

MOFA每折初始化最多10个因子，训练期间按 `dropR2=0.01` 过滤不活跃因子；之后用训练所得 `Z` 的实际列数 `k` 决定该折随机森林的输入维数。

不调用原保存的全27人模型因子。W、Z和Tau全部从本折同一个Python后端读取，避免因子重新排序。
输出选择特征数和MOFA实际保留特征数，二者可能因训练集零丰度/无方差过滤而不同。
测试者不参与MOFA训练、中心化或缩放参数估计；高斯后验使用权重二阶矩。本诊断版使用同一投影公式获取训练者和测试者因子表示，并保存投影相对于MOFA原始Z的相关性、斜率、截距和RMSE。

```{r mofa}
fit_fold <- function(h,m,tr,j){
 arrays<-list(host=h,microbiome=m)
 arrays<-lapply(arrays,function(x){
  x<-x[apply(x[,tr,drop=FALSE],1,sd)>1e-8,,drop=FALSE]
  sweep(x,1,rowMeans(x[,tr,drop=FALSE]),'-')
 })
 stopifnot(all(vapply(arrays,nrow,1L)>0))
 for(view in names(arrays))rownames(arrays[[view]])<-paste0(view,'::',make.unique(rownames(arrays[[view]])))
 ent<-entry$entry_point()
 ent$set_data_options(scale_views=FALSE,center_groups=TRUE)
 ent$set_data_matrix(lapply(arrays,function(x)list(t(x[,tr,drop=FALSE]))),
  views_names=names(arrays),samples_names=list(ids[tr]),
  features_names=unname(lapply(arrays,rownames)),likelihoods=list('gaussian','gaussian'))
 ent$set_model_options(factors=as.integer(mofa_max_factors),ard_factors=FALSE,ard_weights=TRUE,
  spikeslab_factors=FALSE,spikeslab_weights=FALSE)
 ent$set_train_options(iter=1000L,seed=42L,verbose=FALSE,
  dropR2=mofa_drop_r2)
 ent$build();ent$run()
 nodes<-ent$model$getNodes()
 w<-nodes[['W']]$getExpectations();z<-as.matrix(nodes[['Z']]$getExpectation())
 tau<-nodes[['Tau']]$getExpectations();k<-ncol(z)
 if(is.null(k) || k<1L) stop('MOFA没有保留因子，fold=',j,
      '。请检查本折训练数据与预设dropR2阈值。')
 stopifnot(nrow(z)==length(tr),k<=mofa_max_factors)
 # 投影/随机森林后续维度使用实际k；不再假设固定为6
 precision<-diag(k);rhs<-matrix(0,k,n)
 for(ii in seq_along(arrays)){
  ww<-as.matrix(w[[ii]][['E']]);ww2<-as.matrix(w[[ii]][['E2']])
  tt<-colMeans(as.matrix(tau[[ii]][['E']]))
  xx<-arrays[[ii]]
  stopifnot(nrow(ww)==nrow(xx),length(tt)==nrow(xx))
  precision<-precision+crossprod(ww,tt*ww)+diag(colSums(tt*pmax(ww2-ww^2,0)),nrow=k)
  rhs<-rhs+crossprod(ww,tt*xx)
 }
 projected<-t(solve(precision,rhs))
 # Diagnostic: a high correlation does NOT imply the same projection scale.
 projected_train <- projected[tr,,drop=FALSE]
 z_original <- z
 check <- vapply(seq_len(k),function(q)
  suppressWarnings(cor(projected_train[,q],z_original[,q])),numeric(1))
 slope <- vapply(seq_len(k),function(q)
  cov(projected_train[,q],z_original[,q])/var(z_original[,q]),numeric(1))
 intercept <- colMeans(projected_train) - slope*colMeans(z_original)
 rmse <- sqrt(colMeans((projected_train-z_original)^2))
 diagnostic <- data.frame(fold=j,held_out=ids[j],factor=seq_len(k),
  train_projection_cor=check,projection_vs_z_slope=slope,
  projection_vs_z_intercept=intercept,projection_vs_z_rmse=rmse)
 write.csv(diagnostic,
  file.path(out,sprintf('fold_%02d_projection_check.csv',j)),row.names=FALSE)
 if(any(!is.finite(check)) || min(check)<0.90)
  warning('Fold ',j,': Gaussian projection differs markedly from original MOFA Z; ',
          'interpret projection-based AUC cautiously.')

 # Key correction: use THE SAME posterior projection for train and test.
 # Estimate centering and scaling using the 26 TRAINING projections only.
 mu <- colMeans(projected_train)
 sdz <- apply(projected_train,2,sd)
 if(any(!is.finite(sdz)|sdz<1e-10))
  stop('Degenerate projected factor variance in fold ',j)
 ztr <- scale(projected_train,center=mu,scale=sdz)
 ztest <- scale(projected[j,,drop=FALSE],center=mu,scale=sdz)
 colnames(ztr) <- paste0('Factor',seq_len(k))
 colnames(ztest) <- colnames(ztr)
 stopifnot(nrow(ztr)==length(tr),nrow(ztest)==1L,
           ncol(ztr)==k,ncol(ztest)==k,all(is.finite(ztest)))
 # Fixed, outcome-independent seed schedule. Not tuned to increase AUC.
 set.seed(123+j)
 rf<-randomForest(x=ztr,y=train_label[tr],ntree=rf_ntree,importance=TRUE)
 probability<-as.numeric(stats::predict(rf,ztest,type='prob')[,'1'])
 saveRDS(list(training_ids=ids[tr],held_out=ids[j],z_train=ztr,z_test=ztest,
  z_original_training=z_original,projection_diagnostics=diagnostic,
  W=w,Tau=tau,feature_names=lapply(arrays,rownames),centered_inputs=arrays,
  initial_factors=mofa_max_factors,retained_factors=k,
  dropR2=mofa_drop_r2,random_forest_ntree=rf_ntree,
  random_forest=rf),file.path(out,sprintf('fold_%02d_model.rds',j)))
 list(probability=probability,n_factors=k,n_host=nrow(arrays$host),
  n_microbe=nrow(arrays$microbiome),projection_diagnostics=diagnostic)
}
```

## 5. 单组学随机森林：仅使用本折筛选出的对应组学

这里使用前面同一折计算出的 `host$matrix`（冻结VST）及 `micro`（CLR）。
模型不会重新筛选整队列特征，也不会读取测试者标签。

```{r single_omics}
fit_single_rf <- function(x,tr,j,model_name) {
 stopifnot(is.matrix(x), ncol(x)==n, model_name %in% c('Host','Microbiome'))
 # 与MOFA一致：仅按训练者方差过滤，测试者不能参与过滤。
 usable <- apply(x[,tr,drop=FALSE],1,function(a) all(is.finite(a)) && sd(a)>1e-8)
 x <- x[usable,,drop=FALSE]
 if(nrow(x)==0) stop('No usable ',model_name,' features in fold ',j)
 if(any(!is.finite(x[,j,drop=FALSE]))) stop('Nonfinite held-out features in fold ',j)

 xtr <- t(x[,tr,drop=FALSE])
 xte <- t(x[,j,drop=FALSE])
 feature_names <- make.unique(paste0(model_name,'::',rownames(x)))
 colnames(xtr) <- feature_names
 colnames(xte) <- feature_names
 stopifnot(identical(colnames(xtr),colnames(xte)),
           nrow(xtr)==length(tr),nrow(xte)==1L,
           length(unique(train_label[tr]))==2L)
 # 与整合模型一致的RF参数以及同折随机数种子。
 set.seed(123+j)
 rf <- randomForest(x=xtr,y=train_label[tr],ntree=rf_ntree,importance=TRUE)
 probability <- as.numeric(stats::predict(rf,xte,type='prob')[,'1'])
 if(!is.finite(probability)) stop('Invalid ',model_name,' prediction in fold ',j)
 saveRDS(
  list(model_name=model_name,training_ids=ids[tr],held_out=ids[j],
       features=rownames(x),random_forest_ntree=rf_ntree,random_forest=rf,
       held_out_probability=probability),
  file.path(out,sprintf('fold_%02d_%s_model.rds',j,model_name))
 )
 list(probability=probability,n_features=nrow(x))
}
```

## 6. 运行27折，并保存三个模型的逐人预测

三个模型使用相同的 `tr` 和 `j`，**Microbiome-only/Host-only 不使用 MOFA 因子**。
`fold_feature_counts.csv` 将同时记录三组模型每折实际使用的特征数量。
每完成一折就保存一次进度；如筛选后任一组学无可用特征，沿用原文件的策略直接停止，不擅自改用top-N。

```{r loocv}
predictions <- data.frame(
 Name=ids,training_label=train_label,
 evaluation_label=train_label,  # 与RF训练标签完全一致：T2中位数高/低二分类
 MOFA=NA_real_,Host=NA_real_,Microbiome=NA_real_
)
counts_by_fold <- data.frame()
fold_screening_audit <- data.frame()
projection_diagnostics_by_fold <- data.frame()
feature_records <- list()

for(j in seq_len(n)){
 tr <- setdiff(seq_len(n),j)
 selected <- screen_features(tr)
 fold_screening_audit <- rbind(fold_screening_audit,
  data.frame(fold=j,held_out=ids[j],selected$audit))
 write.csv(fold_screening_audit,
  file.path(out,'fold_screening_audit.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 # 即使某折没有选到任何特征，也先保存完整检验表以便排查
 prefix <- file.path(out,sprintf('fold_%02d',j))
 write.csv(selected$host_tests,paste0(prefix,'_host_tests.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(selected$dna_tests,paste0(prefix,'_dna_tests.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(selected$rna_tests,paste0(prefix,'_rna_tests.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(data.frame(gene=selected$genes),paste0(prefix,'_selected_genes.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(data.frame(taxon=selected$taxa),paste0(prefix,'_selected_microbes.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(data.frame(taxon=selected$dna_taxa),paste0(prefix,'_selected_dna_taxa.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(data.frame(taxon=selected$rna_taxa),paste0(prefix,'_selected_rna_taxa.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(data.frame(taxon=selected$rna_without_dna),paste0(prefix,'_rna_taxa_missing_DNA_counts.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 if(length(selected$genes)==0 || length(selected$taxa)==0)
  stop('Fold ',j,': no genes or DNA-count-represented species selected. ',
       'Examine fold_screening_audit.csv and fold association tests; do NOT tune p-cutoff using held-out AUC.')
 feature_records[[j]] <- list(
  held_out=ids[j],training_ids=ids[tr],genes=selected$genes,
  microbes=selected$taxa,union_taxa=selected$union_taxa,
  dna_taxa=selected$dna_taxa,rna_taxa=selected$rna_taxa
 )
 saveRDS(feature_records,file.path(out,'fold_selected_features.rds'))

 # 同一组已筛特征、同一次预处理供三个模型使用。
 host <- prepare_host(hc[selected$genes,,drop=FALSE],tr,j)
 micro_raw <- dc[selected$taxa,,drop=FALSE]
 micro_raw <- micro_raw[rowSums(micro_raw[,tr,drop=FALSE])>0,,drop=FALSE]
 if(nrow(micro_raw)==0) stop('No nonzero microbes in fold ',j)
 micro <- log(micro_raw+1)
 micro <- sweep(micro,2,colMeans(micro),'-') # 每个样本的CLR

 ans_mofa <- fit_fold(host$matrix,micro,tr,j)
 ans_host <- fit_single_rf(host$matrix,tr,j,'Host')
 ans_micro <- fit_single_rf(micro,tr,j,'Microbiome')

 projection_diagnostics_by_fold <- rbind(
  projection_diagnostics_by_fold,ans_mofa$projection_diagnostics)
 write.csv(projection_diagnostics_by_fold,
   file.path(out,'MOFA_projection_diagnostics_all_folds.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 predictions$MOFA[j] <- ans_mofa$probability
 predictions$Host[j] <- ans_host$probability
 predictions$Microbiome[j] <- ans_micro$probability

 counts_by_fold <- rbind(counts_by_fold,data.frame(
  fold=j,held_out=ids[j],training_n=length(tr),
  eligible_host_genes=nrow(selected$host_tests),
  eligible_dna_species=nrow(selected$dna_tests),
  eligible_rna_species=nrow(selected$rna_tests),
  selected_genes=length(selected$genes),
  selected_microbe_union=length(selected$union_taxa),
  selected_microbes_in_DNA=length(selected$taxa),
  MOFA_initial_factors=mofa_max_factors,
  MOFA_dropR2=mofa_drop_r2,
  RF_ntree=rf_ntree,
  MOFA_host_features=ans_mofa$n_host,
  MOFA_microbe_features=ans_mofa$n_microbe,
  MOFA_factors=ans_mofa$n_factors,
  Host_RF_features=ans_host$n_features,
  Microbiome_RF_features=ans_micro$n_features,
  VST_type=host$type,VST_training_error=host$error,
  test_above_training_VST_range=host$test_above_training_range
 ))
 write.csv(counts_by_fold,file.path(out,'fold_feature_counts.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(counts_by_fold[,c('fold','held_out','training_n',
  'MOFA_initial_factors','MOFA_dropR2','MOFA_factors','RF_ntree')],
  file.path(out,'MOFA_factors_selected_by_fold.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 write.csv(predictions,file.path(out,'three_model_LOOCV_predictions.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 # 保留原单模型预测文件名，避免使用者旧脚本读取失败。
 write.csv(data.frame(Name=predictions$Name,
  training_label=predictions$training_label,
  evaluation_label=predictions$evaluation_label,
  probability=predictions$MOFA),
  file.path(out,'MOFA_LOOCV_predictions.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
 message(sprintf(
  'Fold %d/%d %s: MOFA retained=%d/%d; ntree=%d; genes=%d microbes=%d; MOFA=%.3f Host=%.3f Microbiome=%.3f',
  j,n,ids[j],ans_mofa$n_factors,mofa_max_factors,rf_ntree,ans_host$n_features,ans_micro$n_features,
  ans_mofa$probability,ans_host$probability,ans_micro$probability
 ))
}
counts_by_fold
```

## 7. 三模型 ROC、AUC、95% CI 与输出

以下均使用**27个未参与其对应折训练的预测概率**。
95% CI 是固定逐人LOOCV预测/标签对的2000次分层bootstrap区间；
bootstrap并没有重跑特征筛选、MOFA和RF，因此不代表整个模型开发过程的置信区间。

ROC与AUC统一使用和随机森林训练相同的 `viral_load_t2` **中位数高/低二分类标签**。输出CSV将记录训练/评价标签和实际中位数阈值。

```{r roc}
model_names <- c('MOFA','Host','Microbiome')
stopifnot(!anyNA(predictions[,model_names,drop=FALSE]),
          identical(predictions$training_label,predictions$evaluation_label))
roc_list <- setNames(lapply(model_names,function(m)
 pROC::roc(predictions$evaluation_label,predictions[[m]],
  levels=c('0','1'),direction='<',quiet=TRUE)),model_names)

set.seed(123)
performance <- do.call(rbind,lapply(model_names,function(m){
 r <- roc_list[[m]]
 ci <- pROC::ci.auc(r,method='bootstrap',boot.n=2000,boot.stratified=TRUE)
 data.frame(
  model=m,training_target='median_T2_viral_load',evaluation_target='median_T2_viral_load',
  n=n,n_positive=sum(predictions$evaluation_label=='1'),
  n_negative=sum(predictions$evaluation_label=='0'),
  cutoff=cutoff,
  AUC=as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)),
  CI_low=as.numeric(ci[1]),CI_high=as.numeric(ci[3])
 )
}))
write.csv(performance,file.path(out,'three_model_AUC_95CI.csv'),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(performance[performance$model=='MOFA',,drop=FALSE],
 file.path(out,'MOFA_AUC_95CI.csv'),row.names=FALSE)

colors <- c(MOFA='#E64B35',Host='#00A087',Microbiome='#3C5488')
draw <- function(){
 old_par <- par(pty='s') # Square plotting region
 on.exit(par(old_par),add=TRUE)
 first <- roc_list[['MOFA']]
 plot(1-first$specificities,first$sensitivities,
  type='l',col=colors['MOFA'],lwd=2.5,
  xlab='1 - Specificity (FPR)',ylab='Sensitivity (TPR)',
  xlim=c(0,1),ylim=c(0,1))
 abline(0,1,lty=3,col='grey75')
 for(m in c('Host','Microbiome')){
  r <- roc_list[[m]]
  lines(1-r$specificities,r$sensitivities,col=colors[m],lwd=2.5)
 }
 lab <- sprintf('%s  AUC %.3f (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f)',
  performance$model,performance$AUC,
  performance$CI_low,performance$CI_high)
 legend('bottomright',legend=lab,col=colors[performance$model],
  lwd=2.5,bty='n',cex=.72)
 mtext(sprintf('Training and ROC: T2 viral load below vs >= median (cutoff=%.4g)',cutoff),
  side=3,line=.3,cex=.8)
}
pdf(file.path(out,'MOFA_Host_Microbiome_ROC.pdf'),width=7,height=7)
draw();dev.off()
png(file.path(out,'MOFA_Host_Microbiome_ROC.png'),
 width=2100,height=2100,res=300)
draw();dev.off()
performance
draw()
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,'sessionInfo.txt'))
```

## 8. 全特征筛选、投影诊断及结果边界

- 宿主恢复原完整免疫相关候选集合（预期约3370个，以实际对象为准），不是560个显著基因。每折26人独立重新筛选；无额外宿主CPM阈值。DNA/RNA仍从本版本既有矩阵出发。
- 宿主在原候选集合直接进行折内关联筛选；微生物在训练内做丰度预过滤后关联筛选。最终基因数和物种数逐折变化；具体见 `fold_screening_audit.csv`。
- RNA中显著、但DNA计数矩阵不存在的物种会被审计，不会伪造DNA计数。若你的科学目标要求把RNA-only物种作为分类输入，需要另行明确建立RNA表达特征视图，不能在此静默混用。
- 必须检查 `hrna_symbol`、`op_dna_species`、`op_rna_species` 是否已被上游结局信息预先过滤；本版从这些**已存在的处理后矩阵**起步，并非对原始reads的完全端到端LOOCV。
- `MOFA_projection_diagnostics_all_folds.csv` 汇总每折原始MOFA Z与高斯后验投影的相关性、线性斜率、截距及RMSE。投影若在训练者上与Z高度相关，但斜率明显偏离1，则原版确实存在训练/测试尺度不匹配风险。
- 本版把训练和测试输入统一为自定义高斯后验投影。它解决**数值表示的一致性**，但不能保证投影就是MOFA2的精确后验，也不能保证AUC必然上升。
- MOFA每折初始化最多10个因子，按26名训练者的数据应用 `dropR2=0.01` 自动剔除低贡献因子；实际数量存于 `MOFA_factors_selected_by_fold.csv`，并非按留出者AUC优化K。
- 三个随机森林（MOFA、Host-only、Microbiome-only）均使用 `ntree=300`，参数应在分析前固定，不应根据AUC反复调参。
- 训练、预测概率、ROC和AUC统一使用T2载量中位数高/低分组：`viral_load_t2 < cutoff`为0；`viral_load_t2 >= cutoff`为1，详见 `T2_median_binary_labels.csv`。
- 特征筛选保留Spearman与Wilcoxon的组合规则；Spearman使用连续载量，Wilcoxon使用中位数高/低组。二者均只在训练折执行。
- **局限：**中位数由全27人T2结局回顾性计算，故阈值本身也利用了留出者结局信息，不能声称这是完全无泄露的前瞻性LOOCV。严格检验应预先或借助外部样本规定cutoff。
- 基于27人的样本量较小，且需要确认上游候选特征集是否由全队列结局筛出；LOOCV性能仍应作为探索性结果解释。
- MOFA、Host、Microbiome三者比较具有相同的受试者拆分和训练规则，但只有在外部上游候选特征并非按全队列结局筛选时，才能进一步主张整个筛选流程未发生结局信息泄露。
- 本Rmd为可在用户原Windows项目环境运行的代码。没有本地 `2025.RData`、DESeq2及mofapy2的可运行环境，无法在此文件中预填真实AUC结果。
